phases.goal: Before robot motion, identify the elevated open endpoint T and base-side point B of the continuous protruding rack bar, set u=normalize(B-T), reject the table and support post, and freeze the episode-local rack geometry.
phases.name: bind_static_rack
phases.verify: T is the free bar endpoint, B and distributed samples lie on the same protruding member, the fitted bar is distinct from the table and vertical post, and a second ordinary camera is consistent when usable.

phases.arm: task-language source arm followed by right receiving arm
phases.goal: Use exact current task-language VLA for pickup, required rotation, stable staging, and receiving-arm acquisition.
phases.name: learned_pick_rotate_and_handoff
phases.verify: The mug is elevated and visibly moves coherently with the closed right receiving gripper; closure or proximity alone is insufficient.

phases.goal: Stop VLA permanently after the verified right hold, expose the handle only with bounded visibility probes, fit a valid full 6-D held-handle frame T_WH, and lock T_EH=inverse(T_WE)@T_WH from the achieved right EE pose.
phases.name: bind_held_handle
phases.verify: A FULL_LOOP fit or every CONSTRAINED_PARTIAL numeric gate passes; T_WH, achieved T_WE, and T_EH are recorded once and later handle vision is not used to rebind.

phases.goal: While clear of the rack, rotate about the latest achieved EE origin so the propagated handle-plane normal aligns to the nearer signed rack axis, then freeze the achieved normalized right EE quaternion as q_transport.
phases.name: align_and_lock_orientation
phases.verify: The propagated handle normal satisfies abs(dot(n_pred,u))>=0.95 and every later analytic move explicitly commands q_transport.

phases.goal: Use the frozen rack anchor, locked T_EH, and each newly achieved EE pose to move the predicted handle center toward C_pre=T-d_pre*u in analytic segments no longer than 0.100 m.
phases.name: achieved_state_transport_to_pre_tip
phases.verify: The final segment reaches the computed collision-clear PRE-TIP relation without crossing T, while the propagated handle error remains within the current clearance budget.

phases.goal: From achieved PRE-TIP, execute one deterministic translation along +u to the computed tip-crossing relation and one deterministic translation farther along +u to the observed-scale interior seating relation.
phases.name: cross_tip_and_seat
phases.verify: Achieved-state propagation places the aperture across the frozen tip and then on an interior bar segment clear of the support post, with maintained hold and budgeted pose error.

phases.goal: Release only after the propagated seating relation passes; then use ordinary observations and the official evaluator to verify rack support.
phases.name: release_and_verify
phases.verify: The mug remains supported by the rack after gripper-object separation and the latest ordinary state or final result reports eval_success=true.

semantic_recipe.relation_to_jsonl: The phases and gates are the transferable policy. The companion JSONL is a historical successful trace; its literal poses, motion count, task language, and timing are provenance and must not be replayed in a new episode.

strategy_notes.coordinate_policy: Re-localize the mug, rack bar, table, current mug-instance handle center/plane/aperture radius, current EE poses, visibility, reachability, and collision context from matching current ordinary RGB/world maps. Never reuse the companion JSONL's xyz, quaternion, pixels, table height, object dimensions, or target relations.
strategy_notes.default_policy_when_preconditions_match: Use the source-success VLA-to-Primitive split and terminal state machine as the same-task default when current task semantics and observation gates match. Supported status gives this task-specific split priority over the generic full-VLA fallback; every current-scene perception, hold, binding, clearance, and execution gate still must pass.

vla_primitive_boundary.before_boundary: Use exact current task-language VLA for source pickup, rotation, staging, and receiving grasp. The opening call may use chunks=2 only in a safely open scene; use chunks=1 near contact and handoff. Permit at most three progressive short receiving continuations while coupling remains recoverable.
vla_primitive_boundary.boundary_gate: Enter Primitive-only control only when ordinary observations verify the elevated mug moving coherently with the closed right receiving gripper.
vla_primitive_boundary.after_boundary: No later VLA call is allowed. Use primitives for handle visibility, binding, alignment, transport, crossing, seating, release, and verification.

rack_binding.axis_definition: T is the elevated free open endpoint, B is on the same bar toward its support, and u=normalize(B-T).
rack_binding.freeze_rule: Bind and audit the static rack before the first robot action, then never replace it with a later mug/gripper-occluded estimate.
rack_binding.pre_tip_rule: Derive C_pre=T-d_pre*u and crossing/seating offsets from the currently observed bar length, bar radius, handle aperture, and collision clearance.

constrained_partial_gates: Use one matching RGB/world-map pair with at least 24 finite inner-rim samples on one continuous visible arc spanning at least 60 degrees.
Require a robust handle-plane fit with maximum retained inlier distance no greater than 0.0035 m after rejecting mug body, table, gripper, and background points.

Fit the aperture radius as a free episode-local parameter from the current mug instance and require median circle radial residual no greater than 0.0035 m; do not import a clean-instance radius interval.
Two disjoint visible-arc half fits may shift the center by at most 0.005 m, change the plane normal by at most 8 degrees, and change the fitted radius by at most max(0.005 m, 0.15*r_aperture).
The inferred center must lie inside the visible handle topology rather than on the mug body, gripper, or a shadow.
handle_binding.visibility_probe_budget: Before binding and while safely clear, use at most two observation-conditioned wrist rotations of at most 15 degrees and at most two free-space translations of at most 0.030 m; preserve the hold and undo a worsening probe.
handle_binding.instance_scale_rule: Estimate r_aperture from the current held mug and r_bar from the current rack. Reject a non-finite, non-positive, short-arc-degenerate, topology-inconsistent, or split-unstable estimate; never substitute dimensions from the source trace.
handle_binding.lock_rule: Compute T_EH=inverse(T_WE_achieved)@T_WH once. After lock, do not change the grasp, visually re-fit the handle, or require terminal handle visibility.

orientation_and_transport.alignment: Choose n_goal as the closer of +u and -u. Rotate at the latest achieved EE xyz; for a rotation above 35 degrees or one direct planning failure, use at most one SLERP halfway pose before the final pose.
orientation_and_transport.pose_conversion: For each desired handle pose, compute the EE target through the locked T_EH. Freeze the achieved alignment quaternion as q_transport and explicitly command it on every later move_to; gripper remains unchanged.
orientation_and_transport.far_transport: Move toward current C_pre in segments no longer than 0.100 m with at least 25 substeps, recomputing from the achieved full EE pose after every completed move.
orientation_and_transport.terminal_transport: From achieved PRE-TIP, issue one computed crossing move and one computed seating move along +u, each with at least 25 substeps and q_transport. Do not replace them with repeated visual millimeter servoing.

execution_gate.clearance_budget: Derive the operational handle-center error budget as min(0.015 m, 0.60*(r_aperture-r_bar)).
execution_gate.required_audit: After every move, compare commanded and achieved EE translation and quaternion, propagate T_WH_pred=T_WE_achieved@T_EH, and use handle-position error rather than EE xyz error alone to decide phase advancement.
execution_gate.undershoot_policy: Safe positive progress with endpoint undershoot is retained and the next target is recomputed from the achieved state. A short correction need not be repeated when the propagated handle is already inside the clearance budget and orientation error remains budgeted.

critical_gates: The initial rack fit identifies the free protruding bar rather than the table, base, shadow, or vertical post.
The right receiving hold is mechanically verified before Primitive-only motion.
A complete 6-D FULL_LOOP or numerically valid CONSTRAINED_PARTIAL handle fit is locked before rackward transport.
The propagated handle normal is aligned to the signed rack axis and the achieved quaternion is explicitly preserved.
PRE-TIP, crossing, seating, and release each require achieved-state propagated handle error inside the current physical clearance budget.
Official success, not primitive completion or visual proximity, is the terminal truth.

roles.manipulated: the mug identified by the current complete task language
roles.source_arm: the source arm required by the current task language
roles.receiving_arm: right arm in the supported source strategy, subject to matching current embodiment and observation
roles.target: the free open endpoint and interior segment of the currently observed rack bar

task_language: Use your left arm to pick the basic mug in solid white, rotate it, set it down, and hang it onto the dark gray rack.
vla_recipe: Historical winning structure: five exact-language VLA calls established the source manipulation and verified elevated right hold; after that boundary the trace used render, bounded wrist visibility rotations, in-place quaternion alignment, three coarse achieved-state-replanned transports, PRE-TIP, tip crossing, seating, and right release. In a new episode the VLA call count is observation-conditioned, every VLA prompt uses the complete current task_language, and every analytic pose is rederived from current geometry rather than copied from the companion JSONL.

notes: A verified right hold can still fail the full 6-D held-handle binding gate; never convert an invalid fit into blind rackward motion.
A full-loop-only visibility rule discarded useful held states. Use CONSTRAINED_PARTIAL only when every listed numeric and topology gate passes.
Unspecified transport orientation previously amplified small EE endpoint residuals through the handle-to-EE lever. Explicitly command the achieved q_transport on every post-alignment move.
Terminal self-occlusion is expected after a valid lock. Propagate T_EH from achieved EE states instead of visually rebinding the occluded handle.
